tracks.label: Bridge & Solutions
tracks.blurb: Roles that pay for the operational judgement you already have, with the AI tooling attached.

why.gap_bridging_angle: Six years running front-of-house scheduling for a 90-seat restaurant is the same job this posting describes: intake from people who do not know what they need, a written procedure they will actually follow, and a weekly number that says whether they followed it. The AI tools here are the ones you already use; the coordination is the part they are hiring for.
risk_factors: Asks for one year in a healthcare setting, and the posting does not say it is flexible.
Hybrid three days a week in Manhattan, which the listing states as non-negotiable.

why.gap_bridging_angle: Two years reconciling driver manifests against invoices at a logistics firm is the reconciliation half of this role already done, in a domain with the same tolerance for being wrong. The SQL is learnable in the window this posting allows; the habit of not trusting an extract is not.
risk_factors: Fully onsite five days, stated in the posting.
Utility hiring cycles are slow; expect months, not weeks.

tracks.label: Re-Entry & Growth
tracks.blurb: Employers who say in writing that a career break or a change of field is not a mark against you.

why.gap_bridging_angle: The posting is explicit that it wants someone who can say why a machine-written answer is wrong, in writing, to the people who build it. Four years of retail escalations is exactly that skill with a different name attached, and the listing asks for no degree and no prior insurance experience.
risk_factors: No compensation stated anywhere in the posting.

tracks.label: AI Integration
tracks.blurb: Roles where you'd wire AI tools into a product or an internal workflow.

why.gap_bridging_angle: Grants operations is deadline work with an audit trail, which is the shape of every shift-handover you have run. The automation half is one tool and a template library, and the posting says they will teach it to whoever they hire.
risk_factors: Compensation is an estimate from the aggregator, not a figure the employer stated.
Grant-funded position; the listing does not say how long the funding runs.
